description: This file defines the Git::I18N Perl module, providing an interface to gettext localizations for Git. It manages locale settings, loads the Locale::Messages library if available, and provides fallback implementations for translation functions.

methods.name: __bootstrap_locale_messages
methods.description: Initializes locale settings and attempts to load Locale::Messages, sets the translation functions or fallbacks accordingly.

methods.name: N__
methods.description: Returns its argument unchanged, used as a marker for xgettext extraction.
